acceptance: OpenAPI specifies stable argument and error contracts with explicit contract-version routes and effect disclosures.

positive.fixture: verified update_stage on its explicit contract route; generated OpenAPI carries the enforced argument schema, every taxonomy status and the effect disclosure

negative.fixture: unserved and older versions, wrong digest, body/route version conflict, bad arguments, duplicate keys, form body, oversize body, missing credential, foreign origin; every runtime reason is classified

versions.primitive: contract schema unchanged; REST interface v1; error taxonomy 37 codes

security_and_source_permissions: Messages are fixed text per code and never carry caller or source values; discover is unauthenticated and states no catalog size.
performance_memory_storage: Not measured at this task; see T08.
known_limitations: OpenAPI for a catalog above 200 operations must be requested per namespace
